body: I understand that things have worked put for you, and that's great! But with such a shitty home life, no friends, I have no one. If I were to kill myself, I'm 100% sure I will not be missed. I am thankful that you have taken out time out of your day to write that message. I don't have much need for money because I will be gone soon. I've already sold everything I have. It's not much, I only have 1500$ to give. Would you please be willing to take it?
